channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: State regulators get an earful on Xcel power shutdowns from Coloradans left without electricity for days
item.description: State utilities regulators collected testimony from 4,000 businesses, households with lifesaving medical equipment and the merely annoyed as they form rules for public safety power shut-offs

item.title: Avian flu hits another Weld County egg farm, Colorado declares disaster
item.description: First commercial chicken outbreak since 2024 has health, ag authorities on alert again

item.title: A flood of proposals to change Colorado peak names — including Longs Peak to Beaver Mountain — faces opposition
item.description: A Colorado attorney has submitted proposals for 97 new names of peaks around Colorado, including changing the name of Longs Peak in Rocky Mountain National Park. The Colorado Geographic Naming Advisory Board did not advance the changes.

item.title: This 73-year-old Puebloan fixes planes for clients like a Saudi prince. Become an airplane mechanic and write your own ticket too.
item.description: Aviation-related jobs are in high demand. Plus: Colorado unemployment rate falls to 3.8%, state adds 23,000 jobs last year and updates from Colorado Springs.

item.title: The Bookies Bookstore suggests titles for both kids and adults
item.description: The Bookies Bookstore in Denver recommends a new tale from a Newberry Award winner, a bookstore fantasy and an instant classic from author George Saunders.

item.title: Encounter with traditional healers in Mexico inspired Tim Weed
item.description: Author Tim Weed's research into hallucinogenic mushrooms in ancient Mesoamerican shamanism led him to a key element in the narrative of "The Gatepost."

item.title: “The Gatepost”: Her father a ghost, woman tries to reconstruct his life
item.description: In "The Gatepost," Tim Weed's story of love and obsession, protagonist Esme Weatherhead returns to her Vermont home to write the story of the father who went missing.

item.title: Carman: Sanitizing history betrays the courageous survivors of American brutality and racism
item.description: One of the most inspiring features of American history is the power of oppressed people to overcome hatred and achieve greatness

item.title: Pea Green Saturday Night launches 20th season at the intersection of music and twang-in-cheek humor
item.description: "At this pace, we will have over 50 seasons by 2056," Pea Green Saturday Night founder Len Willey jokes about the variety shows that combine live music, comedy and a community potluck

item.title: As anti-trans laws exclude athletes, Colorado roller derby leagues are adapting so everyone can skate
item.description: Colorado’s roller derby squads are evolving — again — to provide competition and community as other sports roll back the welcome mat
